metadata.overview: Reports Foundry USA Pool sub-account hashrate, active workers, unpaid balance and daily earnings over the read-only customer REST API, authenticated with a per-sub-account API key or a personal access token.

telemetry.name: hashrate
telemetry.description: Pool-side 5 minute average hashrate across configured sub-accounts.

telemetry.name: workers_online
telemetry.description: Workers with a share in the last 15 minutes across configured sub-accounts.

telemetry.name: balance
telemetry.description: Unpaid credited balance summed across sub-accounts.

telemetry.name: estimated_earnings
telemetry.description: Projected income for the current UTC day: the latest settled FPPS day scaled by the current 24h hashrate.

troubleshooting: If alert.pool_unreachable, verify apiUrl, each sub-account's credential, and outbound HTTPS connectivity.
If alert.hashrate_low, cross-check the fleet's own hashrate before escalating.
